title: com.docker.sandbox/volume@1
description: Config schema for one volume need: a persistent (or tmpfs) path and its characteristics. Instance-shaped, keyed by cleaned path. Matching configurations across Kits merge; differing configurations conflict. Block storage belongs to the owner scope, sandbox name, and cleaned path, and survives sandbox deletion until explicit or disclosed policy removal. The @1 names the capability contract, including this config schema and observable reconciliation and storage-lifetime behavior. RELEASES.md defines when versions move and the maintainer-approved draft-stage exception.

path.description: Sandbox-private destination, compared after path cleaning.

size.description: Dedicated block capacity additive to the root disk when enforced; advisory sizing is disclosed. A RAM limit for tmpfs. Suffixes use powers of 1024. Equivalent byte values match; omission or an empty string is unspecified and differs from an explicit value.

tmpfs.description: Private scratch storage, empty after stop, restart, re-create, or delete; suspend may preserve it with memory. Omission is equivalent to false.

mode.description: Initial permissions, compared by octal value. Reattachment preserves existing permissions; omission or an empty string is unspecified.
